<function name="GetViewSetup" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the current view setup.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="noPlayer" type="boolean" default="false">If `true`, returns the `view->GetViewSetup`, if `false` - returns `view->GetPlayerViewSetup`.</arg>
	</args>

	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table">Current current view setup. See <page>Structures/ViewSetup</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
